notes: THE HIGH ANCHOR. This file is staged only into the verifier image and is never on the agent surface. It is a BAR, not a claim to be the optimum of this space: it is the best retention selection an authoring search over this harness and this frozen run found on the held-out split, and a submission that reaches or beats it scores 1.0. Its distinguishing finding is that the window and the WEIGHTING are separate decisions -- spending all six retention slots on a contiguous tail and then weighting them in proportion to recency beats both the uniform average of the same six and the tighter uniform windows that score best on a naive sweep. The weights are 1..6 normalised by 21. No number from this file is read as a metric anywhere; the verifier evaluates this selection from scratch on every grading run exactly as it evaluates the submission.
